note: Original characters for table use and download. D&D Beyond does not accept character JSON import. This is our pack format, not a Beyond file.

characters.name: Brann Oakholt
features: Fighting Style: Defense (+1 AC, included).
Second Wind (1/rest): bonus action, regain 1d10+4 HP.
Action Surge (1/rest): one extra action.
Improved Critical: 19–20.
characters.gear: Chain mail, shield, longsword, 3 javelins, explorer’s pack, 12 gp

characters.name: Sister Pell Bramble
attacks: Sacred Flame. Dex DC 13; 1d8 radiant, no cover bonus.
features: Disciple of Life: healing spells restore extra 2 + spell level.
Channel Divinity (1/rest): Preserve Life — restore 20 HP split among creatures within 30 ft. (not undead/constructs), up to half their max.
Dwarven Resilience: advantage vs poison; resistance to poison.
characters.gear: Chain mail, shield, warhammer, holy symbol, healer’s kit, 15 gp

characters.name: Nyx Keller
characters.skills: Stealth +7 (expertise), Sleight of Hand +5, Acrobatics +5, Perception +3, Investigation +3; Thieves’ Tools +7 (expertise)
attacks: Rapier. +5 to hit; 1d8+3 piercing. Sneak Attack 2d6 if advantage or an ally is within 5 ft.
features: Cunning Action: bonus action Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Thief: Fast Hands (Cunning Action for Use Object / thieves’ tools); Second-Story Work.
Lucky: reroll 1s on attacks, checks, and saves.
Brave: advantage vs frightened. Naturally Stealthy: hide behind a Medium creature.
characters.gear: Studded leather, rapier, shortbow, 20 arrows, thieves’ tools, 18 gp

characters.name: Ivo Ashletter
attacks: Fire Bolt. +5 to hit; 1d10 fire, range 120.
features: Mage Armor: AC 15 for 8 hours (included only while the spell lasts).
Sculpt Spells: chosen creatures auto-succeed evocation saves and take no damage.
Arcane Recovery (1/day): recover 2 slot levels on a short rest.
Fey Ancestry: advantage vs charm; immune to magical sleep.
characters.gear: Spellbook, dagger, component pouch, scholar’s pack, 22 gp

characters.name: Kael Thornwake
features: Colossus Slayer: once per turn, +1d8 damage to a creature below its HP maximum.
Favored Enemy: undead. Natural Explorer: forest.
Primeval Awareness (1/rest, spell slot): sense favored enemies within 1 mile (6 in forest).
Mask of the Wild: hide in light natural cover.
characters.gear: Scale mail, longbow, 20 arrows, shortsword, explorer’s pack, 11 gp

characters.name: Hester Brine
features: Divine Sense (1/rest, 4 uses): detect celestials, fiends, undead within 60 ft.
Lay on Hands: 20 HP pool, or 5 HP to neutralize one poison or disease.
Divine Smite: expend a spell slot on a hit; +2d8 radiant (1st) or +3d8 (2nd). +1d8 vs undead or fiend.
Channel Divinity (1/rest): Sacred Weapon (CHA to hit for 1 minute) or Turn the Unholy (undead/fiends, Wis DC 13).
Fighting Style: Dueling. Divine Health: immune to disease.
characters.gear: Chain mail, shield, longsword, 3 javelins, holy symbol, 14 gp

characters.name: Rook Helmer
attacks: Greataxe. +5 to hit; 1d12+3 slashing, +2 while raging.
features: Rage 3/long rest (1 minute): advantage on Strength checks/saves; +2 melee Strength damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing.
Unarmored Defense: AC 10 + Dex + Con (15, included).
Reckless Attack. Danger Sense (advantage on Dex saves you can see).
Frenzy: while raging, bonus action melee attack; 1 exhaustion when the rage ends.
Relentless Endurance (1/long rest): drop to 1 HP instead of 0. Savage Attacks: extra weapon die on a crit.

characters.name: Sable Quinn
characters.skills: Persuasion +5, Deception +5, Insight +3, Acrobatics +4, Stealth +4, Perception +3, Investigation +2
attacks: Vicious Mockery. Wis DC 13; 1d4 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack.
features: Bardic Inspiration (d6, 3/long rest, bonus action).
Jack of All Trades: +1 to non-proficient checks. Song of Rest: extra 1d6 on short-rest HD.
Cutting Words: spend inspiration to subtract 1d6 from an enemy attack, check, or damage (reaction).
Fey Ancestry: advantage vs charm; immune to magical sleep.
characters.gear: Studded leather, rapier, lute, diplomat’s pack, 16 gp

characters.name: Bram Willow
attacks: Shillelagh quarterstaff. +5 to hit; 1d8+3 bludgeoning (bonus action to activate).
Produce Flame. +5 to hit; 1d8 fire, range 30.
features: Wild Shape 2/short rest: beast CR 1/2, no fly, 2 hours.
Natural Recovery (1/long rest): recover 2 slot levels on a short rest.
Circle Spells (Forest): barkskin and spider climb always prepared.
characters.gear: Hide armor, shield, quarterstaff, druidic focus, explorer’s pack, 12 gp

characters.name: Sora Palewalk
attacks: Unarmed strike. +5 to hit; 1d4+3 bludgeoning. Martial Arts: bonus unarmed after an attack.
features: Unarmored Defense: AC 10 + Dex + Wis (16, included). Unarmored Movement +10 ft.
Ki 4 points: Flurry of Blows (2 unarmed), Patient Defense (Dodge), Step of the Wind (Dash/Disengage + jump).
Deflect Missiles. Slow Fall (reduce 20 ft of fall damage).
Open Hand Technique: on a Flurry hit, knock prone (Dex DC 13), push 15 ft (Str DC 13), or deny reactions until your next turn.

characters.name: Vexa Ember
attacks: Fire Bolt. +5 to hit; 1d10 fire, range 120.
Breath Weapon (1/short rest): 15-ft cone fire, Dex DC 13, 2d6 fire (half on success).
features: Draconic Resilience: AC 13 + Dex (15, included); +1 HP per level (included).
Font of Magic: 4 sorcery points. Flexible Casting.
Metamagic: Quickened Spell (2 pts), Twinned Spell (1 pt for 1st-level).
Fire resistance (red dragonborn / ancestor).

characters.name: Mael Dusk
characters.class: Warlock (The Fiend, Pact of the Tome)
attacks: Eldritch Blast. +5 to hit; 1d10+3 force, range 120 (Agonizing Blast).

spellcasting.slots: 2 second-level slots, regain on short rest

features: Dark One’s Blessing: when you drop a creature to 0 HP, gain temp HP = CHA mod + warlock level (7).
Dark One’s Own Luck (1/short rest): add 1d10 to an ability check or save.
Invocations: Agonizing Blast, Devil’s Sight (120 ft. magical darkness), Book of Ancient Secrets (rituals).
Hellish Resistance: fire. Infernal Legacy: thaumaturgy; hellish rebuke 1/day as 2nd-level.
characters.gear: Leather armor, dagger, Book of Shadows, 20 gp
